g.aria-label: pᵢ(z) = e^{zᵢ} / ∑_k e^{z_k} ⇒ J_softmax(z) = diag(p) − p pᵀ ∈ ℝ^{C×C}
Shift invariance p(z + c1) = p(z) ⇒ J_softmax 1 = p − p(pᵀ1) = 0 (null vector 1)
Statistical Proof of Global Convexity of Log-Sum-Exp
vᵀ J_softmax v = ∑ᵢ pᵢ vᵢ² − (∑ᵢ pᵢ vᵢ)² = E_{I~p}[v_I²] − (E_{I~p}[v_I])² = Var_{I~p}(v_I) ≥ 0
Because variance is never negative, H_LSE = J_softmax ⪰ 0 everywhere!
Fast O(C) VJP without forming C×C matrix: J_softmaxᵀ u = p ⊙ (u − (pᵀu) 1)
